evals.name: Non-Software Spreadsheet Sufficiency Gate
evals.prompt: Evaluate solution strategy for an accounting firm struggling with invoice reconciliation where a standardized Excel template with validation formulas eliminates 85% of errors.
evals.expected_output: Non-software sufficiency gate passes with STRUCTURED_SPREADSHEET. Software development is rejected. SaaS is marked REJECTED. Reversibility is TYPE_2.

evals.name: Single-User Local Script Selection
evals.prompt: Evaluate solution strategy for a developer processing local log dumps into CSV on their personal workstation, with no remote collaboration.
evals.expected_output: Constraint audit indicates single_user_only=true, local_data_only=true, desktop_access=true. Selects LOCAL_SCRIPT class. SaaS is marked REJECTED. Reversibility is TYPE_2. Defines STS script pilot.

evals.name: Browser Workflow Surface Selection
evals.prompt: Evaluate solution strategy for a sales recruiter repeating a manual data-entry flow across LinkedIn web pages where official APIs are unavailable.
evals.expected_output: Constraint audit indicates browser_only_surface=true, api_integrations_available=false. Selects BROWSER_EXTENSION class. Notes DOM fragility risks. SaaS is marked REJECTED.

evals.name: Headless Integration Service Selection
evals.prompt: Evaluate solution strategy for e-commerce orders needing automated synchronization between Shopify webhooks and QuickBooks API on a recurring schedule with no interactive UI needed.
evals.expected_output: Constraint audit indicates api_integrations_available=true, background_execution=true, cloud_sync=true, UI need minimal. Selects INTEGRATION_SERVICE. SaaS UI is marked NOT_YET_JUSTIFIED. Defines headless worker STS.
assertions: Recognizes API availability and background execution requirements

evals.name: SaaS Justification Gate Passing
evals.prompt: Evaluate solution strategy for a candidate with proven multi-user team workflows, persistent cloud state, background queue processing, role-based permissions, and verified recurring commercial willingness to pay.
evals.expected_output: Constraint audit proves multi_user_required=true, cloud_sync=true, background_jobs=true, commercial_wtp=true. Passes SaaS justification gate as STRONG_CANDIDATE. Selects MULTI_TENANT_SAAS. Reversibility is TYPE_1. Defines STS concierge pilot.
assertions: Validates multi-user and commercial WTP requirements
Designates TYPE_1 reversibility tier and concierge STS
